newsitem.title: EGYPT: Alexandria Portland Cement 95/96 profit up.
newsitem.headline: Alexandria Portland Cement 95/96 profit up.

text.p: Alexandria Portland Cement said on Wednesday that profit available for distribution rose to 56 million Egyptian pounds in the financial year 1995/96 ending in June from 53.20 million in the previous year.
The profit works out at 5.6 pounds for each of the ten million shares. In 1994/95, the company distributed an annual dividend of 34.50 pounds, before it split each of the one million shares into ten.
Paid-in capital was unchanged at 100 million pounds in 1995/96. Shareholders' equity rose to 132.50 million compared to 115 million in 1994/95, a company balance sheet said.
Turnover in 1995/96 rose to 160.79 million pounds from 143.13 million in the previous year.

The state's Holding Company for Chemical Industries holds 79.4 percent of the shares. The balance of 20.06 percent are in the hands of private investors, employees and an Employee Shareholders Association. ($1 = 3.40 pounds)
